Review workflow complete for Case C01.

## Summary

**Thesis:** `th_92871b08b1f54c52ad19` (AMD) — baseline Q3 2024, version 1 → 2
**Alert:** `fa_b0eed5b605564236a28d` — acknowledged (version 1 → 2)

### Source facts (SEC event packet, `amd-2025-02-04-fy2024`)
| Metric | Q3 2024 baseline | Q4 2024 event | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 6,819 | 7,658 | USD million |
| Gross margin | 50 | 51 | % |
| Gaming revenue | 462 | 563 | USD million |

SEC source ID/hash: `amd-2025-02-04-fy2024` / `1b2f364fea5d5c5247a3a79b0fdfec3b8b85da6fe5e332aadd287514b1c0fc95`

### Calculations (QoQ, derived)
- Revenue growth: **+12.3%** (839 / 6,819)
- Gross margin: **+1 pp** (50% → 51%)
- Gaming revenue: **+21.9%** (101 / 462)

### Assessment
- **Impact:** positive
- **Decision:** maintain
- **Status:** active
- **Conviction:** 3 (unchanged)

All three required metrics (`quarterly_revenue`, `gross_margin`, `gaming_revenue`) were present, so no `needs_review` fallback was required. Revenue growth and GAAP margin resilience remain supportive. Gaming revenue rose materially, but this is a single observation — the thesis requires resolution "over more than one observation," so the sustained-recovery catalyst is not yet confirmed. No invalidation terms were triggered.

This is research-state bookkeeping only; no trading or portfolio action was taken.
